description: This Java class implements a Spring Framework condition to determine whether Fineract events are enabled based on environment properties. It checks specific property flags related to different operational modes like read, write, and batch, to decide if the condition matches.

classes.name: EnableFineractEventsCondition
classes.description: Custom Spring Condition that evaluates environment properties to determine whether Fineract events should be enabled based on mode flags.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the Condition interface method to evaluate environment properties and decide if the condition matches.
